prayerTimesForYour: Prayer times for your municipality, a notification when it is time, and the jamaat times from your mosque. Setup takes half a minute.
prayerTimesFromThe: Prayer times from the Islamic Council of Norway
toShowTheRight: To show the right prayer times, the app needs to know where you are. In Norway you get the times from the Islamic Council of Norway. Abroad, the app calculates the times for where you are, using the method common in that country.
noLocationFoundGive: No location found. Give Bønnetid location access in Settings, or continue with {{name}} for now.
chooseYourMosqueAnd: Choose your mosque and get jamaat times and Jumuah right in the app.
youCanChooseA: You can choose a mosque later in Settings.
theAsrTimeDepends: The Asr time depends on the method you follow. If you are unsure, choose IRN standard.
notificationsRequireAnInstalled: Notifications require an installed version of the app. You can turn them on in Settings once you have it.
getANotificationWhen: Get a notification when each prayer begins. Choose the adhan sound and which prayers notify you in Settings.
notificationsAreOnFor: Notifications are on for all five prayers
yourPhoneDeclinedNotifications: Your phone declined notifications. You can allow them in the phone settings later.
markThePrayersYou: Mark the prayers you have prayed. You get a countdown on the lock screen where you can answer without opening the app.
markThePrayersYou2: Mark the prayers you have prayed. You get a notification on the lock screen where you can answer without opening the app.
prayerTimesForAre: Prayer times for {{name}} are ready, with the jamaat times from {{name2}}.
youCanChangeEverything: You can change everything later under More.
